To wipe a Mac - You need to start from a different disk or hard drive and connect to the the machine or hard drive you want to erase. You can't erase a drive if you are actively using it.

So - start from an external drive. Then go to your Hard Drive icon. Click on APPLICATIONS. Scroll down to UTILITIES.

Click on the DISK UTILITY app. Follow this - https://support.apple.com/guide/disk-utility/erase-and-reformat-a-storage-device-dskutl14079/mac

Disk Utility allows you to reformat multiple times, which writes over what you have. It takes awhile. Ol' Hunter could have daisy chained his three laptops together and had them erasing the others.
